Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

future — the time after now. Example: In the future cities will be bigger.
think — to have an opinion in your mind. Example: I think cities will be bigger.
world — the earth and all its people. Example: Technology will change the world.
city — a large town. Example: The city is bigger than the village.
technology — machines and digital tools. Example: Technology will help people.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I think ... will ...
• In the future ...
• Technology will change ...
• Will cities be bigger?
• I think so.
